name: runtime-rust
summary: Build and run Rust apps: a single file with rustc, a project with cargo.
description: Provides the rust runtime (one .rs file, compiled with rustc) and the cargo runtime (a Cargo project, built in release mode; cargo metadata tells which binary and where). It tells OxidePM which programs to run and OxidePM runs them, with your app's environment and a time limit; this adapter starts nothing itself, reads none of your files and has no network. The programs it asks for are cargo and rustc, and the binary they build.
